''See also: [[Orange Light Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Orange [[Light]] is a sentient force or entity associated with the concept of loyalty. It possesses the ability to communicate through speech, offering guidance, judgments, and observations regarding social connections and debts. In combat or physical movement, it manifests as a visible energy that [[Alin]] can use to land on surfaces, levitate himself, or manipulate others. For instance, it has been used to lift a person named [[Simon]] into the air within a protective bubble. This energy is not permanent and can flicker or expire, requiring quick action from its user. The entity appears to act as a moral or strategic commentator, urging individuals to protect their allies and fulfill their obligations to others.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Alin]] utilizes the Orange [[Light]] to manipulate objects upon a cushion and levitate various locks. This power allows him to travel on a wave of light or create bubbles designed to lift and snare, though one such attempt once failed. After [[Simon]] was wrapped in the energy, the Orange [[Light]] revealed itself to be a voice reminiscent of [[Alin]]'s friends. This entity confronted [[Alin]] for acting as an enemy to his allies, yet it claimed a need for him to even the odds. Ultimately, [[Alin]] learned to catch himself using the power and achieved flight on wings of Orange [[Light]].}}
